# חן דוד פור שמאית מקרקעין — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> A real estate appraiser specializing in international clients (Israelis living abroad) who require professional property valuation services. The business emphasizes trust and reliability, offering comprehensive services including property appraisals for inheritance divisions, tax assessments, property reports for foreign declarations, and representation in urban renewal projects. The appraiser brings a unique background combining professional swimming achievements, psychology degree with dean's honors, military service, entrepreneurial experience in protected housing and urban renewal projects in Jerusalem, and current expertise as both an appraiser and real estate investor. The service includes full support with notarized translations, apostille signatures, and document shipping.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About חן דוד פור שמאית מקרקעין
A real estate appraiser specializing in international clients (Israelis living abroad) who require professional property valuation services. The business emphasizes trust and reliability, offering comprehensive services including property appraisals for inheritance divisions, tax assessments, property reports for foreign declarations, and representation in urban renewal projects. The appraiser brings a unique background combining professional swimming achievements, psychology degree with dean's honors, military service, entrepreneurial experience in protected housing and urban renewal projects in Jerusalem, and current expertise as both an appraiser and real estate investor. The service includes full support with notarized translations, apostille signatures, and document shipping.

## Target Audience
לקוחות מחו"ל (ישראלים שגרים בחו"ל)

## Industry
נדל"ן ושמאות
